title: Emergent Relational Order in LLM Agent Societies: From Collective Affect to Authority Stratification

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring cooperative intensity, proposal acceptance rates, and decision authority distribution across varying degrees of social distance (e.g., within-family, family-to-unaligned, and cross-family boundaries) in a multi-agent simulation to observe the relational decay of cooperation.

Conducting cross-model module ablations (DeepSeek-V3, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.5-flash-lite) and analyzing behavioral divergence to determine whether the agents' cooperative behaviors stem from uniform RLHF training artifacts or the underlying cognitive architecture.
